```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def load_npz(path):
    d = np.load(path, allow_pickle=True)
    return pd.DataFrame(d["data"], columns=d["columns"], index=d["index"])

hv_a = load_npz("/Users/useradmin/Desktop/Files/ivol_OEX_historical_volatility_2016-01-01_to_2019-12-31.npz") #change file address as needed
hv_b = load_npz("/Users/useradmin/Desktop/Files/ivol_OEX_historical_volatility_2020-01-01_to_2026-09-30.npz") #change file address as needed
rates = load_npz("/Users/useradmin/Desktop/Files/ivol_interest_rates_USD_2016-01-01_to_2026-09-30.npz") #change file address as needed

# Volatility: combine, parse dates, convert only the numeric columns
hv = pd.concat([hv_a, hv_b], ignore_index=True)
hv["date"] = pd.to_datetime(hv["date"])
num_cols = ["price"] + [c for c in hv.columns if c.endswith("HV")]
hv[num_cols] = hv[num_cols].astype(float)
hv = hv[["date"] + num_cols].sort_values("date").set_index("date")

# Rates
rates["t_date"] = pd.to_datetime(rates["t_date"])
rates["period"] = rates["period"].astype(int)
rates["rate"] = rates["rate"].astype(float)

print(hv.head())
print(hv.tail())
print(rates.head())
```


```{r}
knitr::kable(head(py$hv, 5), digits = 4, caption = "OEX historical volatility (first 5 rows)")
knitr::kable(tail(py$hv, 5), digits = 4, caption = "OEX historical volatility (last 5 rows)")
knitr::kable(head(py$rates, 5), digits = 4, caption = "USD interest rates (first 5 rows)")
```
